name: prairie
note: The Prairie and Sand Hills pack on Meshy, the last batch (8 November 2026): Sand Hills, Prairie Dunes, Ballyneal -- nearly treeless; a few clumps. Plains cottonwood (shared with the Badlands), hackberry, eastern red cedar. Shipped in vendor/blender-meshy_prairie as PrPlainsCottonwood, PrHackberry, PrEasternRedCedar, because the hand-built models hold the plain names.
style: Stylised cartoon game art in soft, flat painted colour. Simple clean shapes with a gentle gradient: darker near the trunk and under each bough, lighter toward the tips. Matte, muted natural palette. No photographic detail, no photo bark, no noise, no speckle, no hard shadows, no highlights, no shine, no ink outlines, no text.
view: One view only, seen from the side at eye level, the whole plant in frame from foot to tip with a margin around it, centred, on a plain white background, in even soft light, with no cast shadow.

models.name: Blender_PlainsCottonwood_1
models.colour: Leaves bright green #6a9440. Bark grey brown #8a8070.
models.prompt: A big old plains cottonwood tree on a prairie golf course, 24 m tall and 22 m wide, as wide as it is tall. The tree stands upright and even, perfectly still on a calm day, nothing swept to one side, no lean. A massive deeply furrowed grey-brown trunk dividing low, at a quarter of its height, into a few huge limbs. The great limbs sweep up and out in a wide vase, clearly visible. Each limb ends in one large solid rounded tuft of foliage, like a soft fluffy cloud, about as tall as it is wide, with a lightly tufted scalloped edge, and smaller tufts sit between them. The tufts are chunky, overlap only a little, and together make a crown with a bumpy outline and several small gaps showing sky and limbs. The tufts make one broad, spreading, rounded crown with a bumpy outline. Paint the foliage as thick, solid three-dimensional forms, never as separate leaves: no visible leaves, no leaf shapes, no lobes, no fine detail, no thin lines, no thin wisps, nothing thinner than a limb. No solid core, no perfect spheres, no flat discs, no round lollipop shape, no even tiers of branches. A slender trunk, one tenth of the tree's height wide near the ground, narrowing gently to two-thirds of that width at mid-height and to thick limbs at the top, its sides never parallel. Only a small flare in the very bottom of the trunk, no wide base. Whole healthy tree, no broken or snapped top. Stylised cartoon game asset, matte hand-painted colour. Single tree alone, no ground, no base, no text.
